MANDARIN MARCH — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MANDARIN MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Functional Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Functional Writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Functional Writing.
